purpose: finite offline kernel verifier/program-test-run review manifest; not authorization
mechanism: fresh anonymous maps, never pinned or attached; no raw sockets or packet transmission
addresses: synthetic fixture constants only; no production service probing
notes: Each source-port variant counts toward the four-run per-case cap; no Cartesian expansion.
All three program paths must share only fresh test maps.
Missing helper/verifier permissions, skipped cases or ambiguous verdicts are failures/inconclusive, never acceptance.
Map TTL is refreshed by accepted outbound replies; no hard absolute expiry claim.
This does not invoke existing attached_packets.py or attach to any interface.
